transcript.text:
Hello, this is Mumbai Bank calling regarding your overdue credit card payment. I’d like to remind you that your payment is pending, and we request you to make the payment at the earliest to avoid further late fees and negative impact on your credit score.

If you are facing any issues with the payment, please let me know—I'm here to help. Prompt payment will also help you avoid any potential legal action. Can you please let me know when you will be able to clear the dues?
Thanks for the call. I understand, but I'll pay soon, just need a few days to sort things out. Please don't worry about it.

Thank you for letting me know. I understand that you need a few days. May I ask when exactly you’ll be able to make the payment? This will help us update our records and avoid any unnecessary reminders.

Additionally, please keep in mind that a further delay can lead to additional late fees and negatively affect your credit score. If you need any assistance, or if you want to discuss a waiver or concession, please let me know—I can help you with that.

Would you like to confirm a payment date now?
I appreciate the offer, but I can’t give an exact date right now. Like I said, it’ll be in a few days. I’m working on it, so no need to stress.

Thank you for your honesty. I understand things might be tight right now. Just a gentle reminder that the late fee of ₹1500 will continue to apply, and interest at around 12% will keep accruing until payment is made. Non-payment can seriously impact your credit score and may even lead to legal action.

If you're having trouble paying the full amount, I can offer you a discount or a waiver—up to 50%—to help you clear your dues. Would you like to discuss this option?

Otherwise, can I check back with you in a few days to follow up? Let me know what works best for you.
Thanks for the discount offer. I’ll think about it and get back if I need help. For now, just check back with me in a few days, please.

Of course, I’ll make a note to check back with you in a few days. If you decide you need help with a discount or waiver, just let me know—I’m here to assist.

Before we end, I also want to mention that Mumbai Bank is offering a festive loan at a special rate of 9.5% if you’re interested.

Thank you for your time. I’ll follow up in a few days. Please try to settle the dues soon to avoid further charges and a negative impact on your credit score.

Have a good day!
Thanks for the info and the call. I’ll try to pay soon. Have a good day too.
